title: "Where does the Ayaub IPFeMac gene set come from"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(magrittr)
library(cowplot)

```

```{r functions}
source(file="functions_bal_macrophages.R")
```

# loading seurat object
```{r}
BAL_macrophages <- load_clean_bal_seurat()
gene_ensb <- BAL_macrophages@misc$features$SYMBOL
names(gene_ensb) <- BAL_macrophages@misc$features$ENSEMBL
features <- BAL_macrophages@misc$features
cluster_names <- c("Monocytes" , "MonoM" , "CD163LGMNM" ,    "AM1"  ,  "AM2"  ,   "ProlifAM")

```

```{r}
color.cluster <- c(
  "Monocytes"     = "#009E73",
  "MonoM"       = "#E69F00",
  "CD163LGMNM" = "#D55E00",
  "AM1"         = "#A020F0",
  "AM2"         = "#0072B2",
  "ProlifAM"   = "#56B4E9"
)
BAL_macrophages@misc$colors$Cluster <- color.cluster
```
# Retrieve fibrosis gene set dictionary
```{r}}
dictionary <- load_clean_dictionary()
genesets_fibrosis<- make_genesets(dictionary = dictionary, key = "IPF")
dict_fibrosis <- make_dict(dictionary = dictionary, key="IPF")
print(genesets_fibrosis%>% str())
```




```{r}
ayaub_self_copied <- c("CD84", "LIPA", "LGMN", "NCEH1", "CCL18", "MYO1E", "CSTB", "HCST", "APOC1", "C9", "PLD3", "ACP5", "CD9", "APOE", "IFI27", "LPL", "GPNMB", "SPP1")
ayaub_self_copied
```

#Are the genes spelled correctly? -yes
```{r}
ayaub_self_copied %in% (features %>% pull(SYMBOL))
```

#What is the overlap of the genes I found and the genes in the published dataset?

```{r}
intersect(ayaub_self_copied, genesets_fibrosis$Ayau_IPFeMp)
```
# Which genes of the published fibrosis dataset are not found in the selfcopied dataset?
```{r}

ggdraw()
woher_kommen_diese_gene <- setdiff(genesets_fibrosis$Ayau_IPFeMp,ayaub_self_copied)
woher_kommen_diese_gene
```


```{r}

    dictionary_raw <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("..", "..", "raw_data", "wendisch_et_al_final", "oli_github", "genesets.xlsx"))
```


```{r}
FeaturePlot(object = BAL_macrophages, features = ensemblizer("FNIP2")) + ggtitle("FNIP2")


for (gene in woher_kommen_diese_gene) {
  a <- FeaturePlot(object = BAL_macrophages, features = ensemblizer(gene)) + ggtitle(gene)
  print(a)
}

```

BAL_macrophages%<>% AddModuleScore(features = list(ayaub_self_copied %>% ensemblizer()), name = "ayaub_self_copied_real")
